<thought>The mass spectrum shows a classic isotopic envelope with peaks spaced ~1.003 Da and relative intensities 100 : 11 : 0.5 : 0.016 : 0.0003 : ~0, which matches the binomial distribution expected for a molecule containing about ten carbon atoms (13C natural abundance ≈1.1 %). This pattern uniquely identifies carbon; other elements (H, N, O, etc.) have much smaller isotopic contributions and cannot be definitively seen here.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
